Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.S. No. 315/2019

Dear Ms. Malhotra,

Thank you for meeting us on 15 October 2019 about your dispute with Sujata Khan. As we understand it, the tenant has sublet the flat without permission. The matter is listed before the Warangal District Court.

Our advice is to collect evidence of unauthorised subletting such as utility bills in the occupant's name. Please collect utility bills in the occupant's name and statements of the neighbours and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹7,85,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
